newsitem.title: USA: Richey says should maintain profit levels.
newsitem.headline: Richey says should maintain profit levels.

text.p: Richey Electronics Inc should be able to maintain its profit levels for the rest of 1997, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer William Cacciatore said Tuesday.

"Although the short-term outlook remains choppy, I believe that we have taken the necessary steps to maintain our profit levels for the balance of 1997, while building a strong platform for the acceleration of growth anticipated by our longer-term market outlook," Cacciatore said in a statement.

The company today reported net income for the second quarter of $1,678,000, compared with $1,735,000 for the 1996 second quarter. Sales rose to $59,346,000 from $58,212,000, an increase of 1.9 percent.

"The second quarter of 1997 saw Richey produce record revenues and near-record profits despite apparent industry-wide gross margin pressure and declining short-term growth expectations among some of its key customers," Cacciatore said.
"We are particularly encouraged by the fact that we have maintained our gross margins in the first half of 1997 compared to 1996," he said.
Richey is a distributor of interconnect, electromechanical and passive electronic components.
